name: pagination
title: Pagination
summary: Page numbers + first / prev / next / last + optional jump-to-page. Mono-numerics. Active page gets lime accent. Truncates with ellipsis for large page counts.
description: Token-driven pagination — numbers + nav buttons + ellipsis truncation.
skillDescription: Use beneath any paginated list / DataTable. Always show first + last + current ± 2 in the middle. Replace large gaps with an ellipsis (...). Provide aria-label='Pagination' on the root.
api: `siblingCount` — number (default 1) — pages shown adjacent to current.
never: NEVER stack pagination above AND below — pick one.
NEVER use Pagination for non-paginated content.
NEVER omit aria-current on the active page.
